title: ADR-019: Server-side diff via base44 function + oasdiff, with local-Worker fallback

done: ADR-005 established oasdiff as the canonical diff engine with an OasdiffPort port
base44/functions/* already hosts proxyFetch, discoverApi, syncIntegrationSpecs — proven runtime pattern
Post-ADR-018 Web Worker handles dereference + diff client-side for small specs
Commit c3eed71 + 0aa8694 made the Worker production-ready with Buffer polyfill and error surface

notes: Server-side diff is a significant architectural change — coordinate with ADR-017 severity work so oasdiff's breaking-change output becomes the severity source of truth
Result cache is the single highest-value component — popular pairs (Stripe, Twilio, GitHub popular version ranges) effectively become instant for ALL users
Keep the Worker path untouched as the fallback — do not remove diff-worker.js

steps.description: Build base44/functions/diffSpecs/entry.ts. Accept { url_a, url_b, mode='structural' }. Hash inputs for cache key. On miss: fetch both specs via proxyFetch internals (or re-implement the same fetch), dereference if needed, shell out to oasdiff via Bun.spawn. Parse oasdiff JSON output, transform to DiffResult[] via a shared domain mapper.
steps.done_condition: function deployed and returns { results, breakingCount, refsResolved, cacheHit, computedAt } for a sample GitHub v1 -> v2 pair in under 5 seconds cold, under 500ms cached

steps.description: Add result cache store (base44/functions/diffSpecs/cache.ts or equivalent). Keyed by sha256(url_a) || sha256(url_b) || mode. TTL 24h, refreshed on hit. Use base44's key-value / object-store primitive (verify which is available in the runtime).
steps.done_condition: second invocation of same pair returns cacheHit=true with <500ms total latency

steps.description: Client adapter: src/adapters/secondary/base44-diff-adapter.ts implements DiffPort by calling base44.functions.invoke('diffSpecs'). Emits onProgress stages matching FetchProgress vocabulary: requesting-diff, server-dereferencing, server-diffing, done. Server may stream intermediate status via SSE or chunked JSON; design the client to accept both final-only and streamed updates.
steps.done_condition: adapter returns DiffResult[] and progress events flow through to UI

steps.description: Expand src/hooks/use-diff-worker.js into src/hooks/use-diff.js. Dispatch logic: if specs came from URLs AND spec size > 200KB AND preferLocalDiff=false, use remote adapter; otherwise use local Worker. On remote 5xx / network fail, auto-fallback to local Worker. Emit a 'fallback' progress event so users see the switch.
steps.done_condition: hook selects the right adapter based on rules; fallback works when remote is down

steps.description: Add Settings toggle 'Prefer local diff (don't send spec URLs to server)'. Stored in localStorage apidiff:preferLocalDiff. Document behavior in the toggle's help text.
steps.done_condition: toggle present in Settings; affects dispatch in use-diff hook

steps.description: Feed oasdiff's breaking-change classification into ADR-017 severity work. If ADR-017 workplan is pending/in-flight, mark it blocked on this step so the classifier uses oasdiff output instead of a hand-rolled heuristic.
steps.done_condition: ADR-017 severity step references oasdiff output as its source

steps.description: Run bun run typecheck, bun test, bun run lint, hex analyze . — boundary rules (adapters never import other adapters, composition-root only import site) must remain clean.
